# Templates for the team

Drafts to work from. Copy them to their real places; don't edit them here.

| For | File | Real destination |
|---|---|---|
| Gulam | `gulam/GUIDE.md` | Read first |
| Gulam | `gulam/example_logs/*` | `sample_logs/` (one example per format) |
| Gulam | `gulam/labels.schema.json`, `gulam/labels.example.json` | `sample_logs/labels.json` |
| Gulam | `gulam/runbook_template.md` | `data/runbooks/<id>.md` |
| Safwan | `safwan/test_checklist.md` | A GitHub issue per test run |
| Safwan | `safwan/video_script_outline.md` | Script for the demo video |

The example logs and `labels.example.json` match: the evidence line numbers point at real
lines, and the labels validate against the schema.
